title: On Waking

chapters.heading: On Waking
chapters.body: The Prophet ﷺ taught the first words of consciousness: 'All praise is for Allah who gave us life after death, and to Him is the resurrection.' Sleep is the daily rehearsal for death; waking, its resurrection. Say it before the screen — let gratitude be the first thing the day touches.
chapters.dua: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
chapters.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Before Sleep (1) — Ayat al-Kursi

chapters.heading: Before Sleep (1) — Ayat al-Kursi
chapters.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'when you go to bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi — a guardian from Allah will stay with you, and no devil will approach you until morning' (Bukhari 2311). The last verse of al-Baqarah's throne-verse: every name of protection, sovereignty, and life compressed into a single passage. One recitation, all night guarded.
chapters.dua: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi before sleep, a guardian from Allah remains over him and no devil approaches him until morning.
chapters.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Before Sleep (2) — The Three Quls

chapters.heading: Before Sleep (2) — The Three Quls
chapters.body: The Prophet ﷺ would recite the three quls, blow into his palms, and pass them over his face and what he could reach of his body — three times (Bukhari 5017). The complete shield: the purity of faith, the refuge from creation's harms, the refuge from the whisperers. Three small surahs the whole family can memorize in a week.
chapters.dua: Recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, and an-Nas; blow into the hands; wipe over whatever you can reach of the body.
chapters.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Entering the Home

chapters.heading: Entering the Home
chapters.body: 'In the name of Allah. O Allah, I ask You the good of entering and the good of leaving. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.' The Prophet ﷺ taught it as the entering-dua; with it, Shaytan tells his companion: 'no lodging or supper here tonight' (Muslim 2018). The threshold is a border — cross it with the Name and the house changes citizenship.
chapters.dua: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
chapters.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلَجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Before Eating

chapters.heading: Before Eating
chapters.body: Begin with Bismillah; if you forget at the start, say: 'Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu — in the name of Allah, its beginning and its end' (Abu Dawud 3767). The table is where the family gathers — let the Name gather it first.
chapters.dua: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ نَسِيتَ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
chapters.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ نَسِيتَ فَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: After Eating

chapters.heading: After Eating
chapters.body: 'All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.' The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah is pleased with the servant who eats a morsel and praises Him for it, and drinks a sip and praises Him (Muslim 2734).
chapters.dua: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
chapters.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: The Journey

chapters.heading: The Journey
chapters.body: 'Allah is the Greatest' three times — then: 'Glory to Him who subjected this to us, and we could never have accomplished it ourselves; and indeed, to our Lord we will return' (Qur'an 43:13-14). The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says it, Allah says: you are granted protection' (Abu Dawud 2602). Board the plane, start the car — the same dua carried camels and now carries engines.
chapters.dua: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
chapters.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: The Heart's Unrest

chapters.heading: The Heart's Unrest
chapters.body: 'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, incapacity and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by men' (Abu Dawud 1551). The Prophet ﷺ taught it to a companion whose anxiety left him. Say it slowly — one breath per clause.
chapters.dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
chapters.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: The Dua of Distress

chapters.heading: The Dua of Distress
chapters.body: 'There is no deity but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.' The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says it in distress, Allah relieves him (Bukhari 6346).
chapters.dua: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
chapters.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: The Debtor's Dua

chapters.heading: The Debtor's Dua
chapters.body: 'O Allah, suffice me with Your halal against Your haram, and enrich me by Your bounty from all besides You' (Tirmidhi 3565). The dua of Ali (RA) taught by the Prophet ﷺ. For every wallet stretched thin by a buy-now age.
chapters.dua: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
chapters.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: For the Sick

chapters.heading: For the Sick
chapters.body: 'Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind; heal — You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness.' The Prophet ﷺ taught it; recite it over the sick seven times (Bukhari 5675). Pair it with the doctor — tawakkul never cancelled the means.
chapters.dua: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاوُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
chapters.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاوُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: When Struck by Loss

chapters.heading: When Struck by Loss
chapters.body: 'Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with better.' Umm Salama said it at her husband's death, and the Prophet ﷺ said: 'if you do this, Allah will reward you and give you better' — and she was later married to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (Muslim 2123). The loss is real; the return is real; the replacement is His specialty.
chapters.dua: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
chapters.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Istikhara's Heart

chapters.heading: Istikhara's Heart
chapters.body: 'O Allah, if You know this matter to be good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and my outcome — decree it for me, ease it for me, and bless me in it. And if You know it to be bad for me — turn it away from me, turn me away from it, and decree good for me wherever it is.' After two rak'ahs, say it and then walk — the answer rides on ease or on closed doors (Bukhari 6382).
chapters.dua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي... وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ شَرٌّ لِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي
chapters.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ

title: For Parents

chapters.heading: For Parents
chapters.body: 'My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small' (17:24). The dua embedded in the verse of their right. For living parents it covers their old age; for those gone, it keeps the door between the worlds open — the child's dua for the parent is answered without veil.

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: For the Children

chapters.heading: For the Children
chapters.body: 'Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous' (25:74). The dua of Ibrahim's tradition. Pair it with the named dua over each child by name — the Prophet ﷺ prayed for Abdullah ibn Abbas by name and he never forgot it.
chapters.dua: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
chapters.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

title: Breaking the Fast

chapters.heading: Breaking the Fast
chapters.body: 'The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills' (Abu Dawud 2357). The Prophet ﷺ said: the fasting person has two joys — one at iftar, one at meeting his Lord (Bukhari 1904). The dua is the small door between the two.
chapters.dua: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
chapters.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: When It Rains

chapters.heading: When It Rains
chapters.body: 'O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour' (Bukhari 1032). And when the rain falls hard: 'O Allah, around us and not upon us' (Bukhari 1014). The weather, like everything else, is addressed to its Owner first.

familyQuestion: Which person in your life needs this dua most this week — and will you tell them you prayed it?

title: Entering the Mosque

chapters.heading: Entering the Mosque
chapters.body: 'I seek refuge in Allah the Magnificent, in His noble countenance and His eternal authority, from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah; peace and blessings upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.' Then two rak'ahs of greeting before sitting (Bukhari 1163).
chapters.dua: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
chapters.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
